description: This file defines a Java interface for a scheduled job service responsible for handling SMS message sending within the Apache Fineract project. It declares methods to send batches of triggered SMS messages, optionally specifying a provider.

classes.name: SmsMessageScheduledJobService
classes.description: Interface for scheduling SMS messages for sending. Declares methods for sending triggered SMS batches.

methods.name: sendTriggeredMessages
methods.description: Sends a batch of SMS messages grouped by campaign to the SMS gateway.

methods.name: sendTriggeredMessage
methods.description: Sends a collection of SMS messages to a specified provider.
